title: Atlantic City
original_lyrics:
[bridge]
Well they blew up the chicken man in Philly last night
Now they blew up his house too
Down on the boardwalk they're gettin' ready for fight
Gonna see what them racket boys can do
Now there's trouble busin' in from outta state
And the .. can't get no relief
Gonna be rumble out on the promenade
And the gamblin' commission's hangin' on by the skin of its teeth
Well now everything dies baby that's fact

[bridge]
Put your makeup on fix your hair up pretty
And meet me tonight in Atlantic City
Well I got job and tried to put my money away

[bridge]
So I drew what I had from the Central Trust
And I bought us two tickets on that Coast City bus
REFRAIN
Now our luck may have died and our love may be cold but with you forever I'll stay
We're goin' out where the sand's turnin' to gold
So put on your stockin's baby `cause the night's getting cold
And everything dies baby that's fact

[bridge]
Now I been lookin' for job but it's hard to find
Down here it's just winners and losers
And don't get caught on the wrong side of that line
Well I'm tired of comin' out on this losin' end
So honey last night I met this guy and I'm gonna do little favour for him
ALTERED REFRAIN
Well I guess everything dies baby that's fact

[bridge]
Put your make-up on fix your hair up pretty
And meet me tonight in Atlantic City
Will you meet me tonight in Atlantic City
